title: R' Abba Mari, Brother of R' Yosi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the places Hyman lists, the supplied text sometimes gives this amora's name as ר״א מאי: Terumot, end of chapter 8; Orlah, beginning of chapter 3; Pesachim, end of chapter 1 and 2:1, 11b; Megillah 4:1; Shekalim 2:4; Ketubot 6:5; Nazir, end of chapter 5.
The supplied text also has R' Akhmari, brother of R' Yosi: Berakhot, chapter 7, end of halakhah 1; Shabbat 3:6 and 9:4; Taanit 1:3.

notes.text: The source gives the unusual form ר״א מאי; its exact resolution remains uncertain. The brother-Yosi designation follows the heading.

The two saved whole Venice scalars, Terumot 8 array[3][4] and Orlah 3 array[0][3], give Abba Mari brother of Yose, supporting the named subject and first two locations. They do not establish supplied ר״א מאי or the separate Akhmari form. A second Terumot occurrence mentioned in a search report was not separately returned or read here. No letter repair or authority merge is adopted. The Pesachim additional יא: is retained literally beside conventional 11b; all other chapter/halakhah/end locators remain. Abbreviated titles of the uninspected Akhmari/Yosi occurrences stay R'.

Hyman's print (vol. I, p. 58) has ר״א מרי and ר׳ אבמרי where the supplied text has ר״א מאי and ר׳ אכמרי. The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:1 (Venice 11b), Shabbat 3:6 and Taanit 1:3 call him Abba Mari, brother of Yose. Shabbat 9:4 gives Abba Mari without the brother designation in that passage. The supplied forms and locators are preserved.
